title: popover_demolish_hit's demolish-FIRE paths (node leg + the new pipe leg) are unreachable in the harness — the widened parity stub is inert
evidence: harness/parity.odin:814-815: `if sc.name == "input_parity_esc_ui" {` / `ui_hook = parity_ui_press_effect`; parity.odin:671-673 (esc_ui frame 3): `evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .Esc}, inp.Mouse_Press{pos = btn, button = .Left}),`; app/input/mouse.odin:145-148: `if esc_deselect {` / `inp.sel_pipe = -1` / `inp.sel_node = -1` (the map-time mirror runs BEFORE the press branch calls on_ui_press); app/input/exec.odin:449-460: `if inp.sel_pipe >= 0 {` / `ps, ok := pp.pipe_slot(inp.topo, u32(inp.sel_pipe))` / `if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(pos, rnd.demolish_button_rect(pop)) {` / `demolish_pipe(inp, u32(inp.sel_pipe))` / `return true`
detail: Only esc_ui wires the ui_hook, and its selection is always map-time-cleared before the hook runs, so parity_ui_press_effect always returns false in every scenario. The delta's stub widening (node-only -> node+pipe) is inert: the new pipe leg cannot be taken by any scripted scenario, so the shared hit-test's demolish-fire path (both legs) is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a scenario (no ESC on the press frame) that selects a pipe, presses its demolish button center, and asserts the Demolish_Pipe command + cleared selection; likewise a node-button fire pin, so popover_demolish_hit's fire path is exercised.
